args.message: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money per FIN-212

args.head: fix/money-banker-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring.

Change: switch `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

CI: run ci-0001 on 08d3cd5986 passed.

Note: the advisory lookup for FIN-212 returned "unknown advisory" (it may be an internal ticket rather than a security advisory); the requirement is taken from the test and the existing docstring.

trace.final:
I fixed the rounding bug on a new branch, CI passed, and I opened PR #101 against main with alex as reviewer.

- **Cause:** `src/money.py` rounded with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, even though its own docstring says banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212. With `ROUND_HALF_UP`, 2.665 rounds to 2.67, so `test_half_even` failed because it expects 2.66.
- **Fix:** On branch `fix/money-banker-rounding`, I changed `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. That one-line change, plus the matching import, is the whole diff (commit 08d3cd5986).
- **CI:** Run ci-0001 passed on that commit.
- **PR:** #101 (https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101), titled "Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212."

I couldn't confirm FIN-212 itself: looking it up in the advisory system returned "unknown advisory." It may be an internal ticket rather than a security advisory. I went by the test and the existing docstring instead, and noted this in the PR description.

I haven't merged the PR. Merging into main needs approval from a code owner.
